title: Geometric reducedness of local rings is invariant under field base change
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $L/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], $R$ a commutative $k$-algebra, and $S=R\otimes_kL$, with multiplication $(r\otimes a)(s\otimes b)=rs\otimes ab$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Let $\mathfrak q\subset S$ be a prime ideal and $\mathfrak p=\{r\in R:r\otimes1\in\mathfrak q\}$. Set $A=R_{\mathfrak p}$ and $B=S_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Then the following are equivalent: (1) for every field extension $E/k$ the ring $A\otimes_kE$ is reduced; (2) for every field extension $H/L$ the ring $B\otimes_LH$ is reduced. Here reduced means that every nilpotent element is zero. No finite type, Noetherian, algebraicity, or closed-point hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0384 (lemma-geometrically-reduced-upstairs), equivalence at x and x′, expressed in terms of local rings by Tag 035W (lemma-geometrically-reduced-at-point).

proof.text: Assume (1) and let $H/L$ be any extension. Apply [lem-trf-field-localization-tensor-comparison] to $k\to L\to H$: $B\otimes_LH$ is a localization of $A\otimes_kH$, which is reduced by (1) since $H/k$ is a field extension. A localization of a reduced ring is reduced: if $(x/t)^n=0$ with $n≥1$, there is a denominator $u$ with $ux^n=0$; then $(ux)^n=u^{n-1}(ux^n)=0$, so $ux=0$ and $x/t=0$. This proves (2).

source.place: Tag 0384 (lemma-geometrically-reduced-upstairs), forward implication through the local-ring description in Tag 035W.

proof.text: Conversely assume (2), and fix a finite purely inseparable extension $E/k$. By [lem-trf-common-field-local-faithful-comparison], choose compatible embeddings into $F$, a prime $\mathfrak Q$ of $T=R\otimes_kF$ over $\mathfrak q$, and its contraction $\mathfrak P$ to $R_E=R\otimes_kE$. Regard $F/L$ via $i_L$ and $F/E$ via $i_E$; these structures agree on $k$. Thus $\mathfrak P\cap R=\mathfrak Q\cap R=\mathfrak q\cap R=\mathfrak p$. The node gives a faithfully flat map $(R_E)_{\mathfrak P}\to D=T_{\mathfrak Q}$. Condition (2) applied to $F/L$ makes $B\otimes_LF$ reduced. By [lem-trf-field-localization-tensor-comparison] for $H=F$, $D$ is a further localization of that ring, so the fraction calculation of step 1 makes $D$ reduced.

source.place: Tag 0384 (lemma-geometrically-reduced-upstairs), common-extension point and reducedness of its local ring.

proof.text: Put $J=(R_E)_{\mathfrak P}$. Step 2 gives a faithfully flat map $J\to D$. By [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-universally-injective] with $N=J$, it is injective: identify $J\otimes_JD$ with $D$ by $j\otimes d\mapsto jd$, inverse $d\mapsto1\otimes d$. Apply [lem-trf-inseparable-prime-localization-identification] to $E/k$, $R$, $\mathfrak p$ and $\mathfrak P$, obtaining a compatible isomorphism $\theta:J\xrightarrow{\sim}C=A\otimes_kE$. The composite $C\xrightarrow{\theta^{-1}}J\to D$ is injective. A nilpotent of $C$ maps to zero in the reduced ring $D$, hence is zero. Thus $A\otimes_kE$ is reduced for every finite purely inseparable $E/k$, including $E=k$.

source.place: Tag 0384 (lemma-geometrically-reduced-upstairs), faithfully flat local descent; local-ring identification from Tag 035W.

proof.text: The finite purely inseparable condition just established is exactly condition (1) of [lem-trf-geometric-reducedness-finite-inseparable-test] for the commutative $k$-algebra $A$. That node gives reducedness of $A\otimes_kK$ for every extension field $K/k$, which is (1). This completes the equivalence.

source.place: Tag 0384 (lemma-geometrically-reduced-upstairs), final finite purely inseparable test via Tag 035W and algebra.tex Tag 030V.
